title: ticfac Phase 6: multi-epic composition
description: SPEC §12 Phase 6. ticfac run <scope> --max-epics N as a scheduler over independent run-epic primitives; concurrency first across different repository coordination keys; same-repository N>1 only after tick-ID, learnings-file, merge-driver, lease/status and freshness tests pass; serialized publication, stale integrated gates rerun, semantic frontier review rerun where a changed target can invalidate it.
acceptance_criteria: Gate: two epics in the same repository complete concurrently with serialized publication and no stale gate.
